understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK with a target position removes clickable breakable blocks when valid and does not move the player; clicks can open required fall paths. Landing on spikes ends the attempt. UNDO reverts the previous action. Each level provides two attempts with a limited turn budget, and passage columns should be used to reach new sections.
